entities.summary: Nikolai Anisimovich Shchelokov was a Soviet statesman and army general who served sixteen years as Minister of Internal Affairs from 17 September 1966 to 17 December 1982. He was fired from all posts on corruption charges and committed suicide on 13 December 1984.
